lines.en: label harukainviteaff:
scene harukainvitegen
Haruka and I spend the night relaxing on my bed, alternating between watching videos on her phone and random television shows on my...well, television.
lines.zh: 我和 Haruka 晚上在我床上放松，一会儿看她手机上的视频，一会儿看我那台……电视上的节目。

lines.en: Our arms press up against one another as we struggle to make good use of what little space there is on this bed.
lines.zh: 床上的空间小得可怜，我们俩挤在一起，胳膊贴着胳膊。

lines.en: It's not something I mind, but it's something that makes me feel a little bit strange whenever I recall the fact that she belongs with someone else.
lines.zh: 我并不介意，只是每次想起她其实是属于别人的，心里就有点说不出的怪。

lines.en: Instead of backing away, though, I only move closer.
lines.zh: 但我没有退开，反而靠得更近。

lines.en: Close enough that I can feel her breath on my skin whenever she turns to me to explain some meme I don't understand.
lines.zh: 近到她每次转过来给我解释什么我看不懂的梗时，我都能感觉到她的呼吸落在我皮肤上。

lines.en: And I guess you could say that I feel her breath pretty often given that virtually every single meme she shows me makes little to no sense to me.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，我经常能感觉到她的呼吸，因为她给我看的几乎每一个梗我都完全看不懂。

lines.en: It's surprising how youthful Haruka is despite being so close to my age, but-
lines.zh: Haruka 明明和我差不多年纪，却年轻得让人惊讶，不过——

lines.en: if nikidate5 == True:
I suppose I can also be youthful for my age at times.
lines.zh: 我想我有时候也能算得上比实际年龄年轻。

lines.en: else:
That age is really just my estimation of this {i}body's{/i} age.
lines.zh: 那个年龄其实只是我对这具{i}身体{/i}年龄的估计。

lines.en: How old was I before I showed up here?
lines.zh: 我来到这儿之前，到底多大？

lines.en: scene black
I shrug off an impending mid-life crisis and chalk my lack of Internet knowledge up to a lack of overall interest in the topic.
lines.zh: 我把即将到来的中年危机耸耸肩推掉，把自己对网络的无知归咎于对这个话题本身缺乏兴趣。

lines.en: But just because it's not my cup of tea doesn't mean I'm going to force Haruka into doing something she doesn't want to do.
lines.zh: 但这不合我口味，并不代表我要逼 Haruka 做她不想做的事。

lines.en: And, as long as I'm able to keep feeling her breath on my neck and the light pressure of our arms as we squeeze closer on the bed, I have everything I came for.
lines.zh: 只要还能感觉到她呼在我脖子上的气息，还有我们在床上越挤越近时手臂传来的轻微压力，我想要的就都有了。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
if bonus == True:
It's a horrible thing to say, but I'm glad I coaxed her into cheating on her husband.
lines.zh: 这话说出来很难听，但我很高兴自己劝动了她背着她丈夫出轨。

lines.en: else:
It's a horrible thing to say, but I'm glad I decided to start hugging her behind her husband's back.
lines.zh: 这话说出来很难听，但我很高兴自己决定背着她丈夫抱她。

lines.en: I like Haruka a lot. And each time the two of us are alone together like this, I become even more aware of that.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢 Haruka。每次我俩像这样独处，我就更清楚这一点。

lines.en: Sure, it's not something even close to love- and I definitely don't have any intention of ever {i}proposing{/i} to her.
lines.zh: 当然，这离爱还差得远——我也绝对没打算哪天向她{i}求婚{/i}。

lines.en: But her company is strangely calming if you're able to kill off all of the negative aspects that come along with it.
lines.zh: 但只要能把她身上那些负面部分都掐掉，她的陪伴就有种奇特的安抚作用。

lines.en: else:
Part of me wonders how things would have been if I had pushed her into a more intimate relationship when I had the chance.
lines.zh: 我有时候会想，如果当初有机会时我把她推进一段更亲密的关系，事情会变成什么样。

lines.en: And moments like this make me feel like there is an infinite amount of chances. An infinite amount of opportunities to destroy what she loves most.
lines.zh: 而这样的时刻总让我觉得，机会是无限的。毁掉她最珍爱之物的机会，也是无限的。

lines.en: But all I've ever done is destroy things- and it gets boring after a while.
lines.zh: 但我这一生做过的只有毁掉东西——而这事做久了也会腻。

lines.en: If what it takes to preserve her long-shot at happiness is a slightly more mundane life, it won't kill me to trade away some of that fun.
lines.zh: 如果保住她那点渺茫的幸福需要的是稍微平淡一点的生活，那拿掉一些乐趣也死不了人。

lines.en: I might not need Haruka, but it's becoming clear that she needs someone else.
lines.zh: 我也许不需要 Haruka，但越来越明显的是，她需要一个人。

lines.en: And today, I just happen to be the closest thing to her.
lines.zh: 而今天，恰好我就是离她最近的那个。
